title: Integral quotient internal projection arrow
statement: Use the actual integral quotient coefficient maps of [def-sfb-integral-quotient-coefficients] and the specified internal derived adjunction and scalar interfaces of [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons]. Construct the cartesian coefficient pullback $Lf^*S_{n,Y}\to S_{n,X}$ from ordinary restriction/pullback comparison, the monoidal unit and the exact inverse-image computation counit. Define the projection arrow $(Rf_*K)\otimes^L S_{n,Y}\to Rf_*(K\otimes^L S_{n,X})$ as the canonical module-object projection map $Rf_*K\otimes^LS_{n,Y}\to Rf_*(K\otimes^LLf^*S_{n,Y})$ of [def-sfb-module-object-projection-map], over the integral coefficient ring, followed by $Rf_*$ of $K\otimes^L$ this coefficient pullback. Equivalently, it is the adjunction transpose of the canonical derived tensor pullback comparison followed by the tensor of the integral counit and the coefficient pullback. This is the internal expression of the projection morphism of [def-weil-pbc-projection-formula-map].
